summary: Trello and Microsoft Planner style boards for Windows, Linux and Android, with Trello and Planner import and an optional self-hosted server.
description: A kanban planner with boards, buckets and cards, labels, checklists, priorities, progress, due dates and repeats, plus board, list, calendar, timeline and chart views and a My Day page. Imports Trello JSON exports and Microsoft Planner Excel or CSV exports. Runs on its own device without an account, or syncs through an optional self-hosted server.
license: MIT
docs: https://docs.zombeatzmedia.com/zomello/
limitations: Targets Trello and Planner board workflows, not their hosted services or APIs. Import only; there is no export back to Trello or Planner formats. No macOS or iOS release yet.

identity.details: Canonical repository unchanged; ZomBeatz owner credited. No additional documented mirrors or Discord community links found in reviewed README/docs.

availability.details: Public, not archived. Repository metadata and source accessible.

maturity.details: Beta explicitly offered by README and official docs. Retained beta/partial. CHANGELOG marks 0.6.0 in progress; current source is newer than the published v0.5.0 prerelease.

features.details: Expanded board/task details, linked tasks, custom fields, time tracking, native board-file sharing and live server collaboration. Trello JSON / Planner XLSX and CSV parsers confirmed in src/importers.ts. Import limits retained explicitly; not a runtime compatibility certification.

websites.details: Official guide and browser demo return 200 with Zomello identities. Demo is an app shell; interaction/persistence not independently exercised. README states changes remain in local browser.

license.details: LICENSE is MIT. README separately excludes project names/logos and identifies Lucide icons as ISC; MIT describes project code, not unrestricted brand rights.

platforms.details: v0.5.0 assets include Windows/Linux desktop, Android APK and Windows/Linux/macOS server binaries. macOS platform added explicitly as server-only; public native macOS/iOS app availability not established.

screenshots.details: Board, calendar, phone and Home PNG URLs return 200 image/png. Added Home dashboard as fourth screenshot.

validation.tests: Not run locally under AGENTS.md; left to PR CI.
validation.duplicates: No existing Zomello repository/slug on main. PR already adds canonical microsoft-planner and reuses trello; no open request for either target found.

unresolved: No independent application runtime or complete import-fidelity validation performed.
Current source features are not all established as present in the older published prerelease.
